title: Kewpie Japanese Mayonnaise 500g
description_en: Kewpie mayo is not like any mayo you've had — it uses only egg yolks (not whole eggs), rice vinegar instead of distilled vinegar, and MSG for that addictive umami-rich flavor. The secret ingredient behind Japanese fusion cuisine worldwide. Japan price is 50% below import cost.
description_ja: キューピーマヨネーズは全卵でなく卵黄のみ使用し、米酢とうま味調味料で世界のどこにもない濃厚な味わいを実現。世界中の日本食レストランが使う隠し味。日本価格は輸入品の半額以下。
